# Upstreams

Aphrody keeps almost no upstream code on disk. Only the checkouts that a build needs live under the source root
(`../source`, override with `APHRODY_SOURCE_ROOT`); everything else is a catalogue entry that is read live.

## Vital checkouts (4)

Restored by `bun run sources:sync` (or `aphrody git source sync --apply`); each is a Cargo path dependency with local patches.

| Id | Origin | Why it stays | Patches |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mcp-server-tauri` | https://github.com/hypothesi/mcp-server-tauri `main` | Cargo path dependency | `patches/tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge-0.13.0-tauri3.patch` |
| `simdutf-rio` | crates.io `simdutf` 0.7.0 | Cargo path dependency | `patches/simdutf-rio-0.7.0.patch` |
| `tauri-plugin-dialog` | crates.io `tauri-plugin-dialog` 3.0.0-alpha.2 | Cargo path dependency | `patches/tauri-plugin-dialog-3.0.0-alpha.2.patch` |
| `serde-saphyr` | crates.io `serde-saphyr` 0.0.16 | Cargo path dependency (held: mistral.rs requires serde-saphyr = "0.0.16" (0.0.x caret is exact); a 0.0.29 or 1.x bump needs a mistral.rs API port first) | `patches/serde-saphyr-0.0.16-regex.patch` |

## Build-on-demand upstreams (4)

Inputs of the WSL build (`config/os/wsl-build.json`, `crates/os/aphrody-wsl`). Restore one with
`aphrody-update sources sync --only <id> --apply` before a WSL build; remove it afterwards with
`aphrody-update upstream prune --apply`.

| `WSL2-Linux-Kernel` | [microsoft/WSL2-Linux-Kernel](https://github.com/microsoft/WSL2-Linux-Kernel) | `linux-msft-wsl-6.18.y` | 1479418068 | WSL2 Linux kernel; kernel build recipe input. | config/os/wsl-build.json; crates/os/aphrody-wsl |
| `terminal` | [microsoft/terminal](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal) | `main` | 2b5336c1fc | Windows Terminal; WSL build recipe input. | config/os/wsl-build.json |
| `wslg` | [microsoft/wslg](https://github.com/microsoft/wslg) | `main` | 6942bb534b | WSLg; system distro build recipe input. | config/os/wsl-build.json; scripts/build/os/build-wslg.py |

## Forks (3)

Every fork needs a reason to exist; `aphrody-update sources forks` compares each with its parent.

| Fork | Parent | Role | Why it stays |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aphrody-labs/bun` | oven-sh/bun | runtime fork (bun:aphrody) | Runtime fork (bun:aphrody): carries the Aphrody native bridges; cannot be replaced by upstream Bun. Procedure: docs/operations/infra/BUN-FORK-OPERATIONS.md. |
| `aphrody-code/oxc` | oxc-project/oxc | Oxc fork (Cargo git dependency) | Carries the native Oxc lint and minifier bridges for Bun (commits not in oxc-project/oxc); the Cargo workspace and the Bun fork both build from it. |
| `koharu-rs/tauri-specta` | - | tauri-specta fork (Cargo git dependency) | Third-party fork, not ours: upstream tauri-specta 2.0.0-rc.25 on crates.io requires tauri ^2 while the workspace is on Tauri 3. |

## Access

| Need | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Catalogue | `aphrody git upstream list`, MCP `upstream_list`, `aphrody-update upstream list` |
| Live repository facts (head, latest release, pushed date, licence, archived) | `aphrody git upstream info <id>`, MCP `upstream_info` |
| Directory listing at the live head | `aphrody git upstream tree <id> [path]`, MCP `upstream_tree` |
| One file at the live head | `aphrody git upstream read <id> <path>`, MCP `upstream_read` |
| Code search inside one upstream | `aphrody git upstream search <id> <query>`, MCP `upstream_search` |
| Full local read (shallow clone in `~/.cache/aphrody/upstream`) | `aphrody-update upstream fetch <id> [--path <dir>]` |
| Drift of the observed heads | `aphrody-update upstream drift`; record them with `upstream refresh --apply` |
| Agent entry point | skill `upstreams` (`plugins/aphrody/skills/upstreams`) |

The Cargo git dependencies (Oxc fork, hf-hub, mistral.rs, tauri-specta fork) are tracked by `aphrody-update sources drift`;
forks by `aphrody-update sources forks`. Procedure for the Bun fork: [BUN-FORK-OPERATIONS.md](../../operations/infra/BUN-FORK-OPERATIONS.md).
